reasoning.step1:
Plan:
- Verify document is an invoice by checking header terms and presence of totals, invoice number/date and VAT info.
- Locate explicit fields: invoice date, sender VAT ID, net, VAT rate, VAT amount, grand total.
- Avoid guessing; extract values exactly as shown (keep decimals and percent formatting rules).

Findings:
- Invoice indicators present: "Rechnung", "RECHNUNGSDATUM: 26/04/2023", invoice number repeated (110800184/20230426), line items, NETTO-WARENWERT and BRUTTO totals.
- Sender VAT ID located near company bank details: "UID-Nr.: ATU19424905".
- Net amount shown as "NETTO-WARENWERT: 3354,49" and repeated as "NETTO GESAMTSUMME 3354,49".
- VAT rate shown as "MEHRWERTSTEUER 10,00 %".
- VAT amount shown as "335,45".
- Grand total / bruto shown as "BRUTTO GESAMTSUMME 3689,94" and "SUMME EUR 3689,94".

No exclusion indicators (e.g., Mahnung) dominate. All required fields are explicitly present; no inference needed.
reasoning.step2:
GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: "BRUTTO GESAMTSUMME 3689,94" and "SUMME EUR 3689,94" and "ZAHLBETRAG 3689,94 EUR" all consistently show 3689,94.
- Consistency: Matches Net + VAT (3354,49 + 335,45 = 3689,94).

Invoice.Date — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: "RECHNUNGSDATUM: 26/04/2023" appears multiple times on pages.
- Consistency: Matches other date references (Warenübernahmebeleg for the invoice dated 26/04/2023).

Sender.VatId — Confidence: High (≈90%)
- Evidence: Company block shows "UID-Nr.: ATU19424905" near bank details on page 1.
- Consistency: Standard VAT format for Austria; no conflicting VAT IDs found (another UID appears for customer: "ATU22642807", but sender UID is clearly labeled).

Vat.Rate — Confidence: High (≈92%)
- Evidence: "MEHRWERTSTEUER 10,00 %" and tax breakdown shows B=10,00% linked to VAT line.
- Consistency: VAT rate 10.00% applies to net 3354,49 producing VAT 335,45.

Net.Amount — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: "NETTO-WARENWERT: 3354,49" and "NETTO GESAMTSUMME 3354,49" shown multiple times.
- Consistency: When combined with VAT yields Grand Total.

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High (≈94%)
- Evidence: Tax line shows "MEHRWERTSTEUER ... | 335,45" and summary shows VAT 335,45.
- Consistency: 10% of 3354,49 = 335,449 — rounded matches 335,45 as printed.
